description: This Java class 'QueryLiveCommandFactory' is a factory for creating immutable instances of various 'LiveCommand' types related to querying live data in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides static methods to instantiate commands for retrieving attributes, features, properties, and things.

classes.name: QueryLiveCommandFactory
classes.description: A final class providing static factory methods to create immutable live command instances for querying data.
